title: Unify SDKs: auth/retries + streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, version bumps
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR unifies auth/retries behavior and streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, fixes parity bugs, and bumps package versions. Motivation: reduce user confusion and maintenance by providing consistent token refresh semantics, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming helper ergonomics across languages so application behavior and tests are portable. Changes include: standardized auth token refresh with a pluggable token provider and background refresh, a single retry/backoff abstraction surfaced in each SDK (with per-language adapters), new streaming helpers that simplify async vs sync usage patterns, ergonomic client constructors that accept unified config objects, several parity bug fixes (header propagation, edge-case reset behavior for KV cache offsets), and coordinated package version bumps. Checklist: [x] design doc updated (ENG-2145) [x] unit + integration tests added [x] e2e streaming smoke tests [x] updated docs and migration notes. Commits are squashed on merge but listed below for review context. See linked Linear items ENG-2145 and ENG-2178 for requirements and acceptance criteria.
